progressSummary: Audited V3-08 requires repair; WIP baseline preserved when a safe delta existed.

openFindings.path: .github/workflows/chorescore-v3-finalize.yml (step 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path', script: | block lines 84-94)
openFindings.problem: The concrete trusted finalizer blocker: the emulator step's multi-line script block is executed line-by-line by reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2 (each line via a separate `sh -c`), and line 1 `set -euo pipefail` fails in dash (Ubuntu /bin/sh) with 'set: Illegal option -o pipefail' and exit code 2. The step therefore fails before `adb install` and before `npm run e2e:android` — the E2E golden path never runs. This is the exact failure of finalizer runs 35293489693 and 35302658175 (annotation 'The process /usr/bin/sh failed with exit code 2'). Even if line 1 were removed, the `apk=$(find ...)` variable is lost between lines (separate shells), so `adb install -r "$apk"` would receive an empty path.
openFindings.evidence: GitHub Actions API: both finalizer runs failed at step 7 with annotation 'The process /usr/bin/sh failed with exit code 2' (check-runs annotations). Action source at the exact v2 tag commit a421e43855164a8197daf9d8d40fe71c6996bb0d: lib/script-parser.js splits on newlines; lib/main.js runs each line via exec.exec('sh', ['-c', script]). Independent simulation: `sh -c 'set -euo pipefail'` → 'sh: 1: set: Illegal option -o pipefail', exit 2; simulation of the full block fails at line 1 with exit 2; simulation without line 1 fails at `adb install -r "$apk"` with an empty path.
openFindings.requiredFix: Change the workflow's emulator step to invoke the golden path as a SINGLE line so the action cannot split it, e.g. `script: bash scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh` (or a single-line `bash -euo pipefail -c '...'`). The workflow file is trusted-shell owned; the Builder provides scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh containing: set -euo pipefail; apk=$(find android/app/build/outputs/apk/release -type f -name '*.apk' | head -1); adb install -r "$apk"; npm run e2e:android. The E2E script already auto-locates the APK and skips install when the package is present, so the script file only needs the same logic in one shell.
openFindings.verification: A trusted finalizer run passes step 7 end-to-end on an API 35 emulator: adb install succeeds, `npm run e2e:android` executes and exits 0, and the golden-path checkpoints (login, groups, tabs, add, balances, todos, back-to-add) are recorded.

openFindings.problem: The candidate does not meet the active criterion: it hardens the E2E script against transient emulator failures (stale dump deletion, swipe/screencap/force-stop try/catch, longer launch sleep), but the script never executes in the finalizer because the workflow fails at line 1 of its script block (see workflow finding). The finalizer would fail again with exit code 2 even with this candidate applied.
openFindings.evidence: Simulation of the action's line-splitting on the workflow's exact script block fails at line 1 (`set -euo pipefail`, exit 2) before any adb or npm command runs; the candidate delta touches only scripts/e2e-android.js; the workflow file is byte-identical on main and lab and unchanged by the candidate.
openFindings.requiredFix: In the next cycle, add the workflow-compatible invocation path: create scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh (Builder scope) with the install + golden-path logic in a single shell, and have the trusted shell change the workflow's emulator step to `script: bash scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh`. Keep the E2E hardening — it is necessary once the script actually runs, and it is coherent (no regressions, trusted verification exit 0).
openFindings.verification: Finalizer step 7 passes end-to-end on a real API 35 emulator with the workflow change and the script file; the hardened E2E script survives transient uiautomator dump / swipe / screencap failures while still failing on genuine golden-path violations.
